extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF text and figure captions; placeholder mechanism-context notes were replaced with bounded cancer-cell pathway claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Brevinin-2R cell death in tested cancer cells is caspase-independent or only weakly caspase-influenced; zVAD-fmk did not efficiently block toxicity, caspase-3/-8/-9 activation was not detected, and caspase-Glo activity showed only trace DEVD-ase activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Brevinin-2R-treated Jurkat, BJAB, and MCF-7 cancer-cell assays
direct_assay_types: zVAD-fmk inhibitor rescue with MTT viability
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is cancer-cell cytotoxicity, not antimicrobial target mechanism; trace DEVD-ase activity is preserved as a caution rather than called absent.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Brevinin-2R toxicity involves mitochondrial dysfunction and BNIP3/Bcl2-sensitive signaling: Bcl2 and dominant-negative BNIP3 protected cells, mitochondrial membrane potential decreased, ROS rose, ATP fell, and mitochondria showed ultrastructural damage without AIF/Endo G release.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Brevinin-2R-treated Jurkat, MCF-7, L929, BJAB and engineered Bcl2/BNIP3 cell lines
direct_assay_types: MTT viability in Bcl2 and dominant-negative BNIP3 lines
JC-1 mitochondrial membrane potential flow cytometry
confocal microscopy for AIF/Endo G localization
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mitochondrial damage is downstream/associated pathway evidence; the paper reports low direct mitochondrial interaction by FITC peptide microscopy.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lysosomal membrane permeabilization and cathepsin/endosome/autophagy-like pathways are directly implicated: Baf A1, zFF-fmk, and CA-074-Me reduced cytotoxicity; lysosomal probe, LAMP/cathepsin-B localization, peptide-lysosome interaction, endosome markers, and autophagosomes support the pathway.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Brevinin-2R-treated MCF-7 and L929 lysosomal/endosomal/autophagy assays
direct_assay_types: Baf A1, zFF-fmk, and CA-074-Me inhibitor rescue with MTT
mechanism_claims.limitations: Cathepsin and autophagy involvement is pathway evidence in mammalian cancer cells; no bacterial target claim is inferred.

mechanism_cautions: Mechanism claims are cancer-cell cytotoxicity pathways and must not be converted into direct antimicrobial mechanism claims.
Graph-only exact timecourse values were not digitized or fabricated.
